reason: I already pay for ChatGPT and it handles my emails and posts when I paste things in. I don't see what 99 euros a month of 'AI co-workers' adds for a business my size, and 100 credits sounds like it could run out fast.
objection: Letting a platform plug into my mailbox and customer files: 'GDPR-compliant' is one line on a website. Where is the data stored, who sees it, and what does a credit actually buy me?
would_change_my_mind: Trying the free plan on my real support inbox and seeing it save me a few hours a week, with data hosted in the EU and a clear data processing agreement.
